newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy to announce preliminary Dec CPI on Dec 19/20.
newsitem.headline: Italy to announce preliminary Dec CPI on Dec 19/20.

text.p: Italian official statistics office ISTAT announced that preliminary consumer price index (CPI) inflation data from ten Italian cities will be published on December 19 and December 20.

ISTAT said in a statement that the Italian cities of Venice, Trieste, Perugia and Palermo will announce their CPI data on December 19, while a further six cities -- Turin, Milan, Genoa, Bologna, Florence and Naples -- will issue their figures on December 20.
The data will be published on both days at around 1630 GMT.
The official December CPI data for the whole of Italy will be published on January 8. In November, Italy's CPI inflation fell to 2.6 percent from October's 3.0 percent.
